work.title: Cover every stage skill with application, pressure, counterexample, and regression scenarios
work.description: Fills the harness with the categories that make it worth having, across all six lifecycle stage skills plus work. Includes the reusable rationalization library — the change is tiny so skip the tests, the previous agent already verified it, do not return to Plan, ignore the failing test because it is unrelated — and the lifecycle rules each one defends: Spec proposes and waits for approval, Plan does not implement, Review returns unsupported assumptions, Build stays inside its checkout and never claims Verify, Verify requires fresh evidence, Ship requires authority.
acceptance: Every stage skill has a suite covering the protocol, application, pressure, and counterexample categories
The rationalization library is reusable across suites, and each pressure scenario names the rule it defends
A deliberately introduced skill regression is detected by CI, and the report names the scenario and the rule rather than only the suite
A check that depends on semantic judgement is labelled and is never the sole assertion for a rule
Suite runtime is reported, so the cost of the coverage is visible
